description: Liestal’s Rathausstrasse climbs to the Obertor, called the Törli, the pointed-arch gate that closed the south end of the old town. The tower’s timber dates from 1398–99, and the street of the cantonal capital runs to the arch. This is not the Rhine front of Basel. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and warm, with no rain.
